title: Conformance suite manifest
description: Declares what contract a suite pins, which implementation is the reference the goldens were generated from, and every implementation known to run it — including the ones with recorded gaps, so a green tick is never over-read.

kind.description: request-payload: builder script -> provider request body. response-parse: raw provider response -> parsed result. roundtrip: value object -> serialized form -> value object. error-code: builder script -> error code. container-identity: two raw JSON strings -> whether this language's parser considers them equal.

pins.description: Prose statement of the contract under test. Not asserted; read by humans deciding whether a change belongs here.

pattern_doc.description: Path to the canonical pattern documentation this suite enforces.

reference.description: The implementation the goldens were GENERATED from by execution. Never hand-authored.

implementations.description: Every implementation known to run this suite, keyed by language. A language absent from here is not covered, and the existence check reads this.

gap.description: Required when status is not 'full'. What is NOT covered, so the green tick is not misread.

runner.description: Repo-relative or repo-qualified path to the runner CLI.

mode.description: The only comparison mode this corpus has. See docs/decisions/0005-canonical-json.md — there is deliberately no float epsilon, because four loaders that each pick their own tolerance are four different contracts.
